champions.name: Vex the Ironclad

innatePassive.name: Unyielding
innatePassive.description: When you take damage, reduce it by 1 (in addition to your Mitigation). Stacks with MG.

tierEffects.name: Battle Forged
tierEffects.description: +5 Attack damage and gain 2 HP whenever you land a Hit on the Chest.

tierEffects.name: Warlord's Resolve
tierEffects.description: Roll 2 D20s and pick the highest for every attack roll.

champions.flavorText: He has never lost a fight he did not start.

champions.name: Lyra Swiftblade

innatePassive.name: First Blood
innatePassive.description: The first Hit you land each game deals double damage. Once per game.

tierEffects.name: Shadow Step
tierEffects.description: +5 Attack and your first attack each Arena turn cannot be blocked (ignore opponent's Avoidance).

tierEffects.name: Death Mark
tierEffects.description: Any time you roll a 15 or higher, apply Bleed (opponent loses 2 HP at the start of their next turn).

champions.flavorText: You will not see her coming. That is the point.

champions.name: Aldric the Stormbringer

innatePassive.name: Arcane Surge
innatePassive.description: Whenever you Crit the Chest, gain +1 extra Resource this turn.

tierEffects.name: Overcharge
tierEffects.description: +5 Attack and Ability cards cost 1 less Resource (minimum 1).

tierEffects.name: Chain Lightning
tierEffects.description: On a Crit in the Arena, deal splash damage equal to half the roll (rounded down) that bypasses Mitigation.

champions.flavorText: He does not control the storm. He is the storm.

champions.name: Seraphine the Blessed

innatePassive.name: Holy Mending
innatePassive.description: At the start of each Raid turn, heal 1 HP.

tierEffects.name: Divine Verdict
tierEffects.description: +5 Attack and Heal 3 HP whenever you play a Talent card.

tierEffects.name: Aura of Wrath
tierEffects.description: Opponent loses 2 HP at the start of every Arena turn (passive aura, no roll required).

champions.flavorText: Her god answers every prayer. Not always favorably.

innatePassive.name: Blood Rage
innatePassive.description: +2 Attack for every 5 HP you are below your maximum. Scales as you take damage.

tierEffects.name: Rampage
tierEffects.description: +5 Attack. If you kill the Chest in one hit, take another turn immediately.

tierEffects.name: Unstoppable
tierEffects.description: Roll 2 D20s and pick the highest for every roll. Also immune to Disadvantage effects.

champions.name: Zara the Voidwalker

innatePassive.name: Void Siphon
innatePassive.description: Whenever the opponent plays a card, gain 1 Resource.

tierEffects.name: Entropy Blade
tierEffects.description: +5 Attack and your Sabotage cards cost 0 Resources.

tierEffects.name: Nullfield
tierEffects.description: Once per Arena turn, you may cancel one Instant card played by the opponent (no cost).

champions.flavorText: She does not steal your power. She erases it.

cards.name: Iron Shortsword
cards.effect: Weapon: +3 Attack on all rolls.
cards.flavorText: Cheap. Reliable. Gets the job done.

cards.name: Reinforced Crossbow
cards.effect: Weapon: +4 Attack. On a Crit, deal +5 bonus damage.
cards.flavorText: Slow to load. Worth the wait.

cards.name: Serpent Fang Dagger
cards.effect: Weapon: +4 Attack. Hits apply Poison (opponent loses 1 HP per turn for 3 turns) in the Arena.
cards.flavorText: The wound is not what kills you.

cards.name: Stormcaller Staff
cards.effect: Weapon: +5 Attack. On a Crit, deal damage to your opponent AND reduce their Mitigation by 2 until end of their next turn.
cards.flavorText: The sky obeys no one. Until now.

cards.name: Voidbreaker Greatsword
cards.effect: Two-Handed Weapon (blocks Off-hand slot): +8 Attack. Attacks ignore Mitigation. On a Crit, the opponent discards a random card from their hand.
cards.flavorText: There is no armor it cannot find its way through.

cards.name: Leather Cap
cards.effect: Head: +1 Avoidance.
cards.flavorText: Not glamorous. Still works.

cards.name: Steel Helm
cards.effect: Head: +2 Avoidance and +1 Mitigation.
cards.flavorText: The dent is from the last fight. He won.

cards.name: Crown of Clarity
cards.effect: Head: +2 Avoidance. At the start of each turn, draw 1 extra card (does not count against hand size limit).
cards.flavorText: A clear mind sees the winning move first.

cards.name: Warlord's Warhelm
cards.effect: Head: +3 Avoidance and +2 Mitigation. When this card loses its last Durability point, deal 5 damage to your opponent.
cards.flavorText: He wore it through nine battles. The tenth man never got close enough.

cards.name: Hide Vest
cards.effect: Chest: +2 Mitigation.
cards.flavorText: It smells. It works.

cards.name: Chainmail Hauberk
cards.effect: Chest: +3 Mitigation.
cards.flavorText: Every link is a decision not to die today.

cards.name: Dragonscale Coat
cards.effect: Chest: +3 Mitigation. When you take 8 or more damage in one hit, this absorbs it and loses 1 Durability instead (once per hit).
cards.flavorText: The dragon did not give it willingly.

cards.name: Aegis Plate
cards.effect: Chest: +4 Mitigation and +1 Avoidance. At the start of your Arena turn, heal 2 HP.
cards.flavorText: Built for the last fight of the war. Worn into every fight since.

cards.name: Worn Gloves
cards.effect: Hands: +1 Resource per turn.
cards.flavorText: More holes than leather. Still a bargain.

cards.name: Merchant's Grips
cards.effect: Hands: +2 Resources per turn.
cards.flavorText: Every coin that passes through these gloves leaves a little behind.

cards.name: Plunderer's Gauntlets
cards.effect: Hands: +2 Resources per turn. When you land a Crit on the Chest, gain +3 bonus Resources that turn.
cards.flavorText: He takes everything that is not nailed down. And then the nails.

cards.name: Goldweave Mitts
cards.effect: Hands: +3 Resources per turn. Once per game, you may carry over up to 3 unspent Resources into your next turn.
cards.flavorText: Worth more than everything they will ever touch.

cards.name: Dusty Boots
cards.effect: Feet: +1 Avoidance.
cards.flavorText: They have walked a thousand miles to this fight.

cards.name: Sprinter's Cleats
cards.effect: Feet: +2 Avoidance. Once per Arena turn, you may re-roll a Miss (1-9) and keep the second result.
cards.flavorText: Fast enough to dodge the first mistake.

cards.name: Shadowstep Boots
cards.effect: Feet: +3 Avoidance. Your opponent's Sabotage Abilities that target your Champion have a 50% chance to miss (flip a coin on resolution).
cards.flavorText: She is never where they aim.

cards.name: Windrider Greaves
cards.effect: Feet: +3 Avoidance. You may play one Instant Ability each turn without spending Resources.
cards.flavorText: Move before they think. Strike before they breathe.

cards.name: Toughness
cards.effect: Passive: Gain +3 Max HP permanently.
cards.flavorText: You do not get tougher by avoiding hits.

cards.name: Quick Hands
cards.effect: Passive: Your hand size increases by 1.
cards.flavorText: More options. Fewer excuses.

cards.name: Lucky Strike
cards.effect: Passive: Rolls of 19 also count as Crits.
cards.flavorText: Luck is just preparation meeting opportunity. A lot.

cards.name: Scavenger
cards.effect: Passive: When you discard a card for Resources, gain +2 instead of +1.
cards.flavorText: One man's discard is another man's treasure.

cards.name: Iron Will
cards.effect: Passive: The first time you drop below 10 HP in a game, immediately gain +2 Mitigation and +2 Avoidance until end of that turn.
cards.flavorText: He does not break. He bends just enough to survive.

cards.name: Battle Rhythm
cards.effect: Passive: On your third consecutive turn of Hitting the Chest (not missing), gain +2 Resources that turn.
cards.flavorText: Momentum is a resource too.

cards.name: Vengeance
cards.effect: Passive: After taking damage in the Arena, your next attack gains +1 Attack for every 2 damage you took. Resets after each attack.
cards.flavorText: Every scar is an argument.

cards.name: Tactical Eye
cards.effect: Passive: Once per turn, you may look at the top card of your deck before deciding to draw.
cards.flavorText: Information is the first weapon.

cards.name: Lifesteal
cards.effect: Passive: Heal HP equal to 25% of the damage you deal in the Arena (rounded up).
cards.flavorText: He does not just take their fight. He takes their strength.

cards.name: Overclock
cards.effect: Passive: During the Raid Phase, gain +1 Resource from every roll result (stacks with Pity, Hit, and Crit bonuses).
cards.flavorText: More in. More out.

cards.name: Shatterproof
cards.effect: Passive: All your equipped Gear gains +1 Max Durability.
cards.flavorText: The best gear is gear that lasts.

cards.name: Apex Predator
cards.effect: Passive: You deal +1 Attack for every piece of Gear currently equipped (each filled slot counts). Maximum +5.
cards.flavorText: Fully geared. Fully lethal.

cards.name: Power Strike
cards.effect: Deal 6 damage to the Chest or opponent Champion.
cards.flavorText: No finesse. Just force.

cards.name: Quick Patch
cards.effect: Restore 1 Durability to any equipped Gear card.
cards.flavorText: Duct tape and a prayer.

cards.name: Bandage
cards.effect: Heal 4 HP.
cards.flavorText: Not pretty. Gets you back in the fight.

cards.name: Focused Aim
cards.effect: Your next attack roll this turn gains +5 bonus (does not stack with other bonuses).
cards.flavorText: Breathe. Aim. Release.

cards.name: Feint
cards.effect: Instant: Play during opponent's attack. They roll with Disadvantage on that attack (roll twice, take lower).
cards.flavorText: Let them think they have you.

cards.name: Backstab
cards.effect: Sabotage: Opponent's equipped Weapon loses 1 Durability.
cards.flavorText: Nothing personal. Mostly.

cards.name: Duel
cards.effect: Both players roll D20. Winner gains 2 Resources. Loser loses their next Chest attack this turn.
cards.flavorText: Put your money where your roll is.

cards.name: Shield Wall
cards.effect: Instant: Play during opponent's Arena attack. Gain +4 Mitigation until end of that attack only.
cards.flavorText: The ground shakes. The wall holds.

cards.name: Poison Flask
cards.effect: Sabotage: Opponent loses 3 HP at the start of each of their next 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: Slow. Painful. Deliberate.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb
cards.effect: Instant: Sabotage. Play during opponent's turn. They roll with Disadvantage on ALL rolls this turn.
cards.flavorText: You cannot hit what you cannot see.

cards.name: Battle Cry
cards.effect: Gain +3 Resources this turn only. Draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: Loud enough to shake the chest. Loud enough to scare the opponent.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.effect: Instant: Heal 8 HP. Can only be played when your HP is below 50% of your Max HP.
cards.flavorText: Not finished yet.

cards.name: Gear Crush
cards.effect: Sabotage: Choose one of the opponent's equipped Gear cards. It loses 2 Durability.
cards.flavorText: Destroy the armor. Destroy the fighter.

cards.name: Execution Strike
cards.effect: Deal damage equal to your D20 roll + your full Attack modifier + 10. Must land a Hit (10+) to trigger.
cards.flavorText: He saves it. For the right moment. Then uses it.

cards.name: Full Repair
cards.effect: Restore ALL Gear cards you control to their maximum Durability.
cards.flavorText: Good as new. Better than new.

cards.name: Perfect Dodge
cards.effect: Instant: Negate all damage from one attack. No roll required. Once per game.
cards.flavorText: Not luck. Pure read.

cards.name: Cursed Blade
cards.effect: Sabotage: Opponent's equipped Weapon loses all Durability and is immediately discarded. Cannot be used if opponent has no Weapon equipped.
cards.flavorText: The curse does not care who holds it.

cards.name: The Killing Blow
cards.effect: Deal damage equal to TRIPLE your D20 roll + all Attack modifiers. On a Crit, this ability resets and can be played again this turn.
cards.flavorText: Some strikes end fights. This one ends careers.

cards.name: Chaos Nova
cards.effect: Deal 5 damage to ALL gear cards the opponent controls (they each lose 1 Durability). Then deal your D20 roll as direct damage to their Champion.
cards.flavorText: It does not discriminate. It destroys everything.

cards.name: Loot Run
cards.effect: Adventure (3 turns): At the end of each turn this is active, gain +1 Resource. When complete, draw 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: In. Out. Loaded.

cards.name: Scout Ahead
cards.effect: Adventure (2 turns): When complete, look at the top 4 cards of your deck and rearrange them in any order.
cards.flavorText: Know the path before you walk it.

cards.name: Bounty Hunt
cards.effect: Adventure (3 turns): Track kills. When complete, gain Resources equal to 2x the number of Hits you landed during those 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: Dead or alive. Preferably dead, for the bonus.

cards.name: Supply Run
cards.effect: Adventure (3 turns): When complete, choose any Gear card from your discard pile and return it to your hand at no cost.
cards.flavorText: Never leave good gear behind.

cards.name: Field Medicine
cards.effect: Adventure (2 turns): When complete, heal 10 HP.
cards.flavorText: You would be surprised what a little rest can fix.

cards.name: The Long Con
cards.effect: Adventure (4 turns): Sabotage. When complete, your opponent reveals their hand. You choose one card from it to be permanently discarded.
cards.flavorText: Patience is the most dangerous weapon.

cards.name: Ancient Ruin Dive
cards.effect: Adventure (4 turns): When complete, add one random Epic or Legendary card (from outside your deck) to your hand for this game only.
cards.flavorText: What is buried is not always lost.

cards.name: The Final Raid
cards.effect: Adventure (5 turns): When complete, deal 20 damage to your opponent's Champion and restore 5 HP to yourself. This Adventure cannot be cancelled by Sabotage.
cards.flavorText: Everything you have built. Everything you have endured. For this.

rarityDistribution.note: Pack pull weights: Common 60%, Rare 25%, Epic 12%, Legendary 3%

deckBuildingRules.gearSlotLimit: One active card per slot at a time (Head, Chest, Hands, Feet, Weapon). Deck can contain multiples as redundancy.

starterDeckSuggestion.name: Iron Path
starterDeckSuggestion.note: A balanced beginner deck for Vex the Ironclad. Solid economy, reliable damage, basic disruption.
